However, it seems that he was pretty unhappy that there were few chances to show off the true powers of the helmet made out of the best material.

Her friends the intellectual and the knight-commander sarcastically commented "Oh, a witch...How out of character." Yet the Guildmaster and the Smith got chills down their spines. That will bring the light of hope into this world."

Ever since this day, more than a few call her Angel instead of Priestess.

The name "Aqua Lord" comes from the silence pressure she released when she wore this hair accessory held people in awe.

It could block any attack with these gauntlets, and even if it was cut the bitter cold of these gauntlets would freeze the wound shut. The chef saw her trying to keep those feeling bottled up, and took her to see the Alchemist out of pity. The outfit started out nice and warm to keep her from catching cold, but Liese's teary puppy-dog eyes convinced her to make this dress.

It was hidden very strictly by those who feared the return of the Demon, but one day it suddenly disappeared without a trace.

Alistela herself apparently memorized the entire library of the Grim Stella coven, yet was totally hopeless at sports. The reason why she chose an austere swimsuit perfect for swimming, may be not to be teased by her friends again.

On its surface are inscriptions in ancient letters: "When the Earth Relic awakens again, the world of eternity rich in nature will come.

He actually declined them at first since the old memory of a fellow Zairyudo pupil weighed on his mind. Quarrels over the nature of their purpose resulted in him abandoning the school. Arth requested a furlough to visit his hometown and settle things between them, since his pride as a swordsman told him he could not be a true master until he did.

As a result, she did not expect a word of thanks from him...but skipping the party to cavort in town was an unforgivable infraction. Her fist of justice struck this effigy square in the face.
